title: fix(metadata-protocol): an action's artifact envelope is grafted only onto the item its package holds at that (object, name)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNTugWasvhTMrtCZiFGrZYK)_
Part of #33456 — this PR lands the envelope half (premise 2). The holder's own route (premise 1) stays open on the card: on main it already answers wherever the engine registry lists the package-less row (#33274's route census), and the one host shape where it still judges no declaration needs a change in `packages/runtime`, outside this PR's surface (see Acceptance notes).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按名读取 action（`GET /meta/action/NAME`、执行面 `getMetaItemForExecution`、以及 `/actions` 路由判出的声明）时，包的工件信封（`_packageId`、`_provenance: 'package'`）只嫁接到该包在同一 `(对象, 名字)` 上持有的那一项；环境自己绑在别的对象（或无对象）上的同名 action 按环境自己的项返回，不再挂别人的包名。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D4 把 action 键成 `(package, object, name)`；原来按名字找信封，ALPHA 绑 `account` 时，环境绑 `contact` 的同名行被当成 ALPHA 的包内项返回（卡 #33456 前提 2，本 PR 在 main 上复测成立）。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `metadata-protocol` 读路径的信封嫁接，不改存储、不改路由、不改 spec；同对象的定制、两包同对象的 409、只有一个包的情形均不变（CONTROL 钉住）；回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-artifact-lookup.ts` 的 `lookupArtifactItem`（风险 hunk：无包时按 `packageScopedHoldersOf` 找唯一同对象持有者）；`protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` 的 `artifactOwnerKeyOf` 与信封调用点。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts -t 33456`，预期 6 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

ADR-0150 D4 keys an action by `(package, object, name)`. The by-name read looked the served item's artifact envelope up by name (`lookupArtifactItem`, which answers the first composite holding the name), so the environment's own action bound to an object no package binds the name to was served wearing the one holder's `_packageId`, `_packageVersion` and `_provenance: 'package'`.

- `lookupArtifactItem` (seam body in `protocol-artifact-lookup.ts`; the private class wrapper in `protocol.ts` threads one more argument) takes an action's owner key. Given, it answers only an artifact bound to that object (or object-less for `undefined`); naming no package, the ONE package whose own artifact is bound there (`packageScopedHoldersOf`, disabled holders included, as the old composite scan was), none for zero or two. Omitted, or for any other type, it is the by-name lookup it was (`lookupArtifactItemByName`, unedited).
- `readMetaItem` (both faces) passes the served item's owner key at its envelope graft, on the plain and the exact-address branch (`artifactOwnerKeyOf`).

Every moved answer, FROM → TO (ALPHA, BETA two packages; `approve` the action name; the environment's item is a package-less row the store holds active):

| Shape | Answer | FROM | TO |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| ALPHA on `account`, the environment's row on `contact` (mirror), both save orders | `GET /meta/action/approve` (RestServer and dispatcher), `getMetaItemForExecution`, the declaration `/actions/contact/approve` judges | the environment's item with `_packageId` ALPHA, `_provenance: 'package'` | the environment's item, no package envelope |
| BETA on `contact` alone, the environment's row on `account` (single-holder cell), both save orders | same three, `/actions/account/approve` | with BETA's envelope | no package envelope |
| ALPHA on `account`, the environment's row object-less | `GET /meta/action/approve` (both transports) | with ALPHA's envelope | no package envelope |

Clause-② arm per row: none. Re-read against ADR-0150 D4 after the diff: each row stops stamping a package onto an item that package does not hold at its `(object, name)` ("A bucket-4 item is therefore one whose `(type, name)` no package holds", read with D4's action key `(package, objectName, name)`); no answer admits anything new and no accepted input is refused, so `Clause-②: no` holds as claimed.

Not changed (CONTROLs pinned): the package-less row on the object the package binds (its customization, under that package's envelope); two packages on one object (409 naming both); one package and no package-less row (its item, its envelope); `?package=HOLDER` (the holder's own item and envelope); the route's `packageId` (unset) and the handler that runs (`ran env`); every type other than `action`; stored rows.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-artifact-lookup.action-owner-key.test.ts` (new, 8 cases): the seam over a registry double: mirror, single-holder cell, the one holder on the item's object among two, object-less both ways, a named package on another object; CONTROLs.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`, describe `#33456` (6 cases each, real `SchemaRegistry` + real protocol): both transports of `GET /meta/action/approve`, three shapes × both registration orders, `?package=` holder control, and the three CONTROLs.
- `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`, inside the `[#32681]` describe (6 cases: real ObjectQL, real `MetadataPlugin` boot pass, `DatabaseLoader` over a writable `sys_metadata` double): mirror and single-holder cell × both save orders on the execution face, the served face and the row's route (declaration envelope, `packageId`, handler run), plus the same-object CONTROL in both orders.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`: the four changed sites recorded with their dispositions.

<details><summary>Ablation readings</summary>

Seam (source-resolved suite): the owner-key rule removed (`ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `if (owner === undefined || singular !== 'action') return artifact;` → `… || true) …`): 5 negative pins red, 3 CONTROLs green; restored, blob equals HEAD (`288b99c4f897`), `git diff HEAD` empty.

Transports and route (they read `metadata-protocol`'s `dist/`): the same rule removed with a bundler-surviving marker (`|| name !== '__ablation_33456__'`), rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` marker present in 2 built files: REST 3 red / 3 green, dispatcher + route 7 red / 5 green (every negative pin red, every CONTROL green); restored, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` exit 0, tree clean. A first dist attempt with the `|| true` spelling was folded away by the bundler (preflight: marker absent), so its readings were discarded and the run repeated with the marker above.

BASE reading (main `1e65a389e1`, runtime #32681 harness, mirror shape): execution face, served face and the row's route declaration all `["custom","contact","com.acme.alpha","package"]`; after: `["custom","contact",null,null]`; holder's exact read `["alpha","account","com.acme.alpha","package"]` both.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise 1 (the holder's own route) is not closed here.** Re-measured on main `1e65a389e1`: in the #32681 boot harness (protocol over a `MetadataManager` boot pass; the engine's ObjectQL registry never lists the package-less row) `/actions/account/approve` (mirror) and `/actions/contact/approve` (cell) still judge no declaration, before and after this PR. Where the engine registry lists the package-less row (the registry-hydrated composition), #33274's `routeHolderCensus` already answers the holder's own declaration (pinned by "#32989 — a served holder's own route", the environment's item on `lead`). The bare execution read cannot see the route's object, so the remaining fix is the route's (`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`), outside this PR's surface; HTTP reach of that host shape is not measured. Carried on the card.
- The merged listing (`getMetaItems({ type: 'action' })`) in the same harness lists only the holder's item, not the environment's row on the other object (measured before and after; `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` is not touched here). Reported to the seat.
